rows.en: －　Aboard the Elan Ship,￥　　Narusawa was doing repairs　－
＊Narusawa＊＠１６０＿００１You lot...￥What are you doing here?
＊Sakaki＊＠１６０＿００２I'm sorry. I told them to come.
＊Narusawa＊＠１６０＿００３You idiot! You're a supervisor,￥you can't...
＊Sakaki＊＠１６０＿００４Wait!￥Something's wrong!!
＊Narusawa＊＠１６０＿００５What's going on?!＝＠１６０＿００６We put out the fire, and we kept￥the damage to the Elan Ship to￥a minimum!＝＠１６０＿００７So what is it now?!
＊Sakaki＊＠１６０＿００８This is strange...＝＠１６０＿００９The explosion on the Elan Ship￥was supposed to be a drill...
＊Narusawa＊＠１６０＿０１０A drill?!￥Then what the hell is this?!
＊Sarai＊＠１６０＿０１１Oh! There you are!￥Hurry, please, get out of here!
＊Sakaki＊＠１６０＿０１２Who are you?!￥What do you want?
＊Sarai＊＠１６０＿０１３Never mind that, hurry!!￥The fire is closing in on the￥ship's power section!＝＠１６０＿０１４At this rate, it won't be safe￥here either!!
＊Narusawa＊＠１６０＿０１５The power section?! No!￥We can't let the Elan Ship burn!￥I'll go and try to stop it!!
＊Sakaki＊＠１６０＿０１６No!!￥It's far too dangerous!￥Your life matters more!!
＊Narusawa＊＠１６０＿０１７B-but if this keeps up,￥the ship will...!
＊Sarai＊＠１６０＿０１８The ship...￥So this is the "ship" that￥will go to Elan...
＊Sarai＊...
＊Sarai＊＠１６０＿０１９I'll go!￥This is about the only thing￥I can do...
＊Sarai＊＠１６０＿０２０I want to be useful to you!￥Please, hurry and get out of￥the ship!!
＊Narusawa＊＠１６０＿０２１Hey! Wait a second!!
＊Narusawa＊＠１６０＿０２２Whoa!＝＠１６０＿０２３No good, it's too dangerous￥here! We have to fall back!!
＊Sakaki＊＠１６０＿０２４But what about that boy?￥We can't just leave him...!
＊Narusawa＊＠１６０＿０２５I won't put the candidates in￥any more danger!＝＠１６０＿０２６Besides, if I'm right about￥this... Anyway, we're pulling￥back for now!!
＊＊－　The fire was soon put out, but￥　　in the ruins...￥　　no one was found.　－
＊＊－　One Month After the Incident　－
＊Narusawa＊＠１６１＿００２The Elan Ship's repairs are￥finally complete.￥Sorry to keep you waiting...＝＠１６１＿００３After an accident like that,￥we're lucky it didn't set us￥back much.
＊Narusawa＊＠１６１＿００４Now, go out there and do us￥proud as an explorer!!＝＠１６１＿００５Look, your partner's￥already here!
＊Sarai＊...
＊Sarai＊＠１６１＿００６It's been a long time...￥I wanted to see you so much...
＊Sarai＊＠１６１＿００７After the accident on the ship,￥I was broken, but the people at￥this facility repaired me.＝＠１６１＿００８Then they recommended to Command￥that I should be sent to Elan...
＊Sarai＊＠１６１＿００９And so now I get to go to Elan￥with you!＝＠１６１＿０１０I'm so, so happy...
＊Sarai＊＠１６１＿０１１I'll do my very best￥to support you!＝＠１６１＿０１２But to think I'm really going...￥It's like a dream.＝＠１６１＿０１３Please take me with you...￥to Elan...
